image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a baby bib lying flat on a textured beige carpet. The bib is primarily white with light blue trim and features a pattern of green cartoonish figures (possibly animals or characters) arranged in horizontal bands. It has a rounded neck opening with white fabric ties at the back. The bottom edge is rounded with blue stitching details. There appears to be some text or logo printed on the upper right side, though it is slightly blurry.
